autoLogin.Name: Auto Log-In
autoLogin.Description: Automatically enters and submits your credentials upon opening the login page.

anonMode.Name: Anonymous Mode
anonMode.Description: Hides or obfuscates any profile related items.

romanToggle.Name: Roman Numerals
romanToggle.Description: Converts all numbers on the page to roman numerals.

discordRPC.Name: Discord Rich Presence
discordRPC.Description: Updates your Discord activity to whatever you're doing on the platform. Requires an app download.

RPCTweaksLogo.Name: Use Tweaks Logo
RPCTweaksLogo.Description: Uses a picture of the OBMC Tweaks mascot for the rich presence instead of the OBMC Butterfly.

RPCShowActivity.Name: Show Activity Name
RPCShowActivity.Description: When taking assessments, shows the current activity name instead of the page name.

RPCShowClassfeed.Name: Show Classfeed Name
RPCShowClassfeed.Description: When opening classfeeds, shows the current feed name instead of the page name.

RPCNotifications.Name: App Status Notifications
RPCNotifications.Description: Updates the user when connectivity to their local RPC app changes.

patriotToggle.Name: Enable Nationalism
patriotToggle.Description: Plays the national anthem of the Philippines.

fastLoad.Name: OB Digi Go Vroom
fastLoad.Description: Makes the platform load faster. This is especially noticable when switching pages.

smartImgs.Name: Smart Image Loading
smartImgs.Description: Keeping this on allows images to lazy load (only load when they're on screen) and decode asynchronously (render at the same time).

keepAnims.Name: Keep Loading Animations
keepAnims.Description: Animations slightly use GPU power and may cause the platform to feel less snappy.

lowDataMode.Name: Low Data Mode
lowDataMode.Description: On slow internet connections, prerendering pages may cause unintended effects. Keep this off otherwise.

notifToggle.Name: Assessment Reminders
notifToggle.Description: Reminds you of your pending activities upon opening the browser. Works while on other sites.

timedReminder.Name: Timed Reminder
timedReminder.Description: Sends you a timed notification (in minutes) based on what you set. Can be disabled when set to 0.

darkToggle.Name: Enable Dark Mode
darkToggle.Description: Toggles a custom dark mode theme.

softCorners.Name: Soft Corners
softCorners.Description: Rounds the corners of most container elements.

sidebarToggle.Name: Collapsible Sidebar
sidebarToggle.Description: Adds a button to collapse the platform's main sidebar.

rmbToggle.Name: Force Right Click
rmbToggle.Description: Forces the platform to allow the right-click menu.

classMultiple.Name: Multiple Feed Tabs
classMultiple.Description:
Allows multiple classes to be loaded simultaneously without corrupting one another.
(Highly experimental. May have limited functionality.)

syncFiles.Name: Sync Class Files
syncFiles.Description:
Files from differing classes will be loaded correspondingly via numerous checks which may adversely affect performance.
(Results vary based on your device.)

classFavorites.Name: Class Favorites
classFavorites.Description: Allows you to pin classes to the top of your class list.

classListOptimizations.Name: Class List Optimizations
classListOptimizations.Description:
Lowers the quality of images within the class list as well as lazy loads them to boost performance on wide screens.
(Results vary based on your device.)

accentColor.Name: Accent Color
accentColor.Description:
Changes the accent colors of the platform to the selected.
(For safety, please disable during assessments.)

accentLink.Name: Allow Link Accents
accentLink.Description: Allows links to inherit the selected accent color.

customBackground.Name: Custom Background
customBackground.Description:
Changes the background image of the platform.
(Recommended image size is 16:9)

grayscaleBackground.Name: Grayscale Background
grayscaleBackground.Description: Dynamically inverts your background's color scheme whenever you switch themes. Intended to be used with grayscale images.

blurBackground.Name: Background Blur
blurBackground.Description: Blurs your selected background from 1px to 100px.

selectedFont.Name: Font Select

Options.label: Gill Sans
Options.value: 'Gill Sans', 'Gill Sans MT', Calibri, 'Trebuchet MS', sans-serif

selectedFont.Description: Changes the font of the platform to the selected.

defaultMiniplayer.Name: Miniplayer / Game
defaultMiniplayer.Description:
Shows a miniplayer that persists throughout the platform.
(For safety, please disable during assessments.)

Special Credits:

  • Lofi Girl - A 24/7 YouTube lofi music stream
  • Samir Paul Lofi - A free "lofi" miniplayer service found while trying to make the previous feature
  • Galaxy Blast - A Galaga-inspired game made by Starboy221, an OBMC student
  • Eaglercraft - A compiled voxel game inspired from Minecraft (1.8) designed to run on Javascript.

disguiseMiniplayer.Name: Disguise Miniplayer as Post
disguiseMiniplayer.Description: Adds a button to posts that lets you duplicate and change its content to contain your miniplayer.
